name: The Continue ~Ano Subarashii Hibi o Mou Ichido~
original_name: The Continue ～あの素晴しい日々をもう一度～
source:
"If you could go back to your boyhood days, what would you do?"
All of a sudden, the protagonist was whisked back in time. A young man once again, he could chose to made love with his loli classmate, his friend's sisters or his friend's mother.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE071770.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
“如果能够回到少年时代，你会做什么？”
主人公突然被时间洪流卷回了过去。重新变回少年的他，可以选择与年幼的女同学、朋友的姐妹，或朋友的母亲发生性关系。
